title: Public FragmentSender can emit wire fragments without LinkLayer policy
description: python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py exposes public FragmentSender(payload).all_fragments()/fragment builders that produce sendable wire fragments without LinkLayer.create_fragment_sender, authenticated peer Rule-version context, session ownership, or one-active-session enforcement. LinkLayer.send accepts the resulting payload. Seal wire emission behind a LinkLayer/SchcSessionManager-issued capability while preserving safe diagnostics, and add tests proving raw construction cannot emit/send policy-bypassing fragments.
notes:
Independent correctness rereview finding: a caller could wrap raw fragment bytes in the SCHC L2 dispatch and bypass _IssuedFragmentWire sealing; origin/forward large packets also dropped instead of routing through Link-issued fragmentation. Fixed with exact regressions; retain in final review scope.
Latest rereview finding: Node large-packet setup failure can abandon a prepared FragmentSender reservation/capability. Ensure every setup/send exception or rejection discards/cancels the prepared sender without freeing a replacement, with regression.
